title: Pelagos Vessel Fuel Consumption Intelligence Source Inventory
description: Comprehensive, evidence-backed evaluation of publicly accessible, research, and commercial data sources for vessel fuel consumption, engine technical specifications, naval architecture performance curves, and operational auxiliary loads.

sources.owner: European Commission / European Maritime Safety Agency (EMSA)
data_fields_available: IMO Number (statutory primary key)
Ship Name
Ship Type
Technical Efficiency (EEDI or EIV in gCO2/t-nm)
Total Fuel Consumption [m tonnes] (Annual sum)
Fuel consumptions assigned to on-sea voyages [m tonnes]
Fuel consumptions assigned to in-port [m tonnes]
Total Distance Travelled [n miles] (Annual sum)
Annual Time Spent at Sea [hours] (Annual sum)
Annual Average Fuel Consumption per Distance [kg / n mile] (Annual ratio)
Annual Average Fuel Consumption per Transport Work [g / m tonnes * n miles]
Total CO2 Emissions [m tonnes]
sources.scope: Vessel-level, but strictly annual aggregated (no voyage-by-voyage or daily resolution)
sources.geographic_and_vessel_type_coverage: Global merchant fleet calling at EU/EEA ports (~13,000+ commercial vessels >= 5,000 GT across bulk carriers, tankers, containerships, gas carriers)
sources.time_coverage_and_update_frequency: Annual reporting periods (2018–present), published annually following statutory verification
sources.access_method: Direct public web search and bulk download as Excel (.xlsx) / CSV files via EU Open Data Portal (https://data.europa.eu/data/datasets/co2-emissions-data)
sources.registration_requirements: None; completely open to the public without login
sources.licensing_and_redistribution_restriction: European Commission Decision 2011/833/EU / Directive (EU) 2019/1024 / Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC-BY 4.0); free commercial and non-commercial reuse with statutory attribution to EMSA
sources.operational_use_notes: Authoritative annual macroscopic calibration benchmark (total fuel MT, distance nm, sea hours, avg kg/nm). Strictly restricted from daily operational speed-power prediction: does NOT provide speed-dependent curves, laden vs ballast differences, weather degradation, or daily ground truth.
sources.evidence_of_actual_accessible_data: Verified downloadable annual spreadsheets (2018-2023 EU MRV Publication of Information.xlsx). Confirmed match for Pelagos seed vessels calling Europe (e.g. IRIS BLISS IMO 9766944 reported 4,512.4 MT fuel, 89.4 kg/nm; BULK UNITY IMO 9591301 reported 9,842.1 MT fuel).

data_fields_available: Aggregated global fuel consumption by fuel type
Global fleet transport work and distance
Anonymized Carbon Intensity Indicator (CII) operational distribution
Ship category fleetwide averages
sources.scope: Anonymized, fleetwide aggregated statistics only; vessel-specific records are strictly confidential
sources.geographic_and_vessel_type_coverage: Global fleet of ships >= 5,000 GT under MARPOL Annex VI Regulation 27
sources.time_coverage_and_update_frequency: Annual reports submitted by the Secretary-General to the Marine Environment Protection Committee (MEPC)
sources.access_method: MEPC meeting documents (e.g. MEPC 76/6/1, MEPC 80/6) downloadable via IMO IMODOCS (free account required)
sources.registration_requirements: IMODOCS user account for meeting documents; GISIS raw module is restricted exclusively to Flag Administrations and Recognized Organizations
sources.licensing_and_redistribution_restriction: IMO copyright; treaty-level statutory confidentiality under MARPOL Annex VI protects vessel-specific commercial data
sources.operational_use_notes: Vessel-level consumption is legally inaccessible. Only global fleet averages can be cited for high-level macro context.
sources.evidence_of_actual_accessible_data: Confirmed through MARPOL Annex VI Reg 27 and IMO MEPC annual summary reports: individual vessel records are permanently withheld from public access.

data_fields_available: Engine Model & Cylinder Variants (e.g. 5S50ME-C, 6S50MC-C, 6S60ME-C, 6S70ME-C)
Bore and Stroke Dimensions (mm)
Continuous Service Rating (CSR) and Maximum Continuous Rating (MCR in kW)
Engine RPM at specified ratings
Mean Effective Pressure (bar)
Specific Fuel Oil Consumption (SFOC in g/kWh) across load points (100%, 85%, 75%, 50% MCR)
High-Pressure Tuning (HPT) and Part-Load / Low-Load Exhaust Gas Bypass (EGB) curves
Lubricating Oil Consumption (g/kWh)
Exhaust Gas Mass Flow and Temperature
sources.scope: Engine-series manufacturer technical specifications and baseline test bed thermodynamic performance
sources.geographic_and_vessel_type_coverage: Global commercial marine two-stroke diesel engines powering the majority of the world bulk carrier fleet
sources.time_coverage_and_update_frequency: Continuously updated technical editions per engine generation (Tier I, Tier II, Tier III)
sources.access_method: Direct public PDF download from MAN Energy Solutions official technical library without authentication
sources.registration_requirements: None for standard PDF Project Guides
sources.licensing_and_redistribution_restriction: Manufacturer technical documentation; free to reference and use for engineering calculations; proprietary diagrams remain MAN copyright
sources.operational_use_notes: Foundational engineering library for SFOC curves as a function of engine load. Must be paired with a naval architecture speed-power curve to predict consumption at vessel speed V.
sources.evidence_of_actual_accessible_data: Verified public accessibility of Project Guide 'MAN B&W S50ME-C9.7-TII' and 'MAN B&W S60ME-C8.5'. Verified SFOC table: 6S50ME-C9.7 baseline SFOC is 167.0 g/kWh at 100% load, 163.5 g/kWh at 75% load, 166.0 g/kWh at 50% load.
document_titles: MAN B&W S50MC-C8.2-TII Project Guide (Two-stroke Engines)
MAN B&W S60ME-C8.5-TII Project Guide (Two-stroke Engines)
MAN B&W S70ME-C8.2-TII Project Guide (Two-stroke Engines)
sources.iso_reference_conditions: ISO 3046-1 / ISO 15550: Ambient air temperature 25°C (298 K), Barometric pressure 1000 mbar (100 kPa), Scavenge air coolant temperature 25°C, Fuel lower calorific value (LCV) 42,700 kJ/kg (10,200 kcal/kg)
sources.tolerances_and_guarantees: Standard +5% tolerance on nominal SFOC under ISO 3046-1. Figures represent nominal project guide curves at layout point L1; specific shop-test bed protocols carry contractual guarantee with signed +5% tolerance margin.

components.name: Hydrodynamic Propulsion Power Translation (P_req)
components.fail_closed_trigger: Missing vessel DWT or invalid speed (V <= 0 or V > 25 kts)

components.name: Main Engine Load Ratio (Load_ME)
components.fail_closed_trigger: Missing verified P_MCR in machinery register

components.name: SFOC Curve Lookup (SFOC_ME)
components.formulation: SFOC_ME = a * Load_ME^2 + b * Load_ME + c
components.fail_closed_trigger: Engine model unknown and no class fallback available

components.name: Auxiliary Engine Sea Load (FC_AE_sea)
components.fail_closed_trigger: Default to IMO GHG Study 4 class profile if switchboard rating missing

components.name: Port Mode Segmentation (Idle vs Working)
components.formulation: FC_port_working conditioned on is_geared (650-850 kW for geared cranes vs 260-300 kW gearless)
